title: Amid warehouse staffing shortages, AI-powered drones and Meta glasses help visually impaired workers get the job done
summary: Facing persistent labor shortages, warehouses are turning to AI-powered drones, Meta smart glasses, and assistive technologies to help visually impaired workers perform inventory management more efficiently and independently.
body_markdown:
The warehousing business is booming as e-commerce sales climb, but many of these sprawling facilities face a challenge after their walls are erected: staffing shortages.


According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ most recent data, 392,000 jobs were open in the warehousing and transportation industries in June, up by 87,000 from a year earlier. High demand from e-commerce, more so than labor availability, is driving the need, Rick Hermanns, the CEO at staffing and talent management firm HireQuest, told Business Insider.
